existing_enforcement_points: Stop-on-sufficiency rule (escalation tasks skipped when mandatory PASS/REUSED)
Fail-closed states: VALIDATION_BLOCKED, INFRASTRUCTURE_BLOCKED, TIMEOUT_BLOCKED, AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION
Task deduplication by command + verification_kind + profile
existing_gaps_for_c50: No unified blast-radius contract that answers all 15 questions from C50 spec
Change surface discovery limited to git diff + path classification; no staged/committed range support
Capability resolution does not explicitly classify: directly_affected, transitively_affected, shared_infrastructure_affected, observable_only, test_only, config_tooling, unmapped
Verification surface expansion from capability is implicit via workflow mappings, not explicit enumeration
Evidence invalidation connected to C47 but not fully integrated with C49 execution plan revalidation injection
Minimum-safe execution scope exists but not exposed as a single 'what-should-i-run' answer
Fail-closed protection exists at plan validation level but not at capability mapping ambiguity level
Latent capability protection not implemented - no audit of imports/registries/mappings before changes
End-to-end scenarios not codified as executable acceptance tests
CLI commands for blast-radius inspection exist (what-should-i-run, control-plane-plan, resolve-capabilities, execution-plan) but not unified under 'blast-radius' subcommand
No explicit 'unmapped != unaffected' enforcement - unmapped capabilities are tracked but don't trigger escalation automatically
Shared infrastructure expansion is conservative via SharedDependencyIndex but not explicitly classified as 'shared_infrastructure_affected'
Test-only changes not explicitly prevented from claiming production capability impact
Configuration/tooling surface changes not explicitly classified and expanded
Frontend/backend boundary verification surfaces not explicitly enumerated
Runtime verification infrastructure changes not explicitly handled
Stale measurement evidence detection exists but reuse rejection not explicitly tied to blast-radius invalidation
Missing evidence vs non-certifiable evidence distinction not surfaced in execution plan
No explicit escalation condition for 'required verification surface has no executable command'
No explicit check for 'current repository state differs from plan derivation state' at execution time beyond fingerprint
c48_c49_integration_points: CapabilityResolver uses CrossLayerImpactPlanner for blast radius
CapabilityResolver uses SharedDependencyIndex for shared module impact
CapabilityResolver uses EvidenceReuse (decide_reuse) for invalidation/reuse decisions
ExecutionOrchestrator consumes ControlPlanePlan and builds ExecutionPlan
ExecutionOrchestrator injects revalidation tasks for stale/missing measurement truth
MeasurementTruthIntegrator evaluates measurement truth against capability contracts
CommandInventory provides canonical command metadata for ExecutionOrchestrator
OperationalQueryEngine provides what-should-i-run CLI from same architecture
